title: Moving Valid Window
summary: Maintain one contiguous active range while the right boundary adds candidates and the left boundary removes items until the range is valid again.
recognition_signals: one boundary adds state while the other removes or expires it
validity can be repaired incrementally after expansion
core_rules: After repair, the active range satisfies the authored validity condition.
The left boundary only moves when removing left-side items can restore validity.
structural_steps: while invalid, remove the left-side item and advance left

common_confusions.distinction: Fixed windows use a predetermined size. Variable windows move the left boundary only as needed to restore a condition.
When signed values break the monotonic repair rule, exact prefix-state lookup can work even though a variable sliding window cannot.
